about: Stones: each of a rank (what a stone of it is worth, of middling size and good water: its value), and Orsino's ways a stone found differs (its gemstone generator): the cut it was given, its size and its clarity, each with what it does to the worth and how it is said. data/generation/templates/treasure.json draws them; src/world/deep/stones.ts names and prices what is drawn.
